title: Python and signed vector families violate mandatory Signer IID framing
description: draft-lichen-link-01 §§3.2-4.1 requires S=1 iff SI=1 and an 8-byte signer EUI-64 covered by the signature. Python LichenFrame still treats bit7 as reserved and every signed link_frame/authenticated_schc_dio/packets-timing generator emits LLSec 0x20 without SIID. Implement mandatory SIID parsing/serialization and link signing/verification in Python, derive the wire signer EUI-64 from the authenticated signer identity, regenerate all signed vector families independently, and make independent/Python/Rust consumers reject S/SI mismatches. C is explicitly out of scope this session.
